English:
My, that was a wonderfully
soothing tune he played.

Wasn't it? Performances that
good only come once in a blue moon.

I feel we owe the bartender of the
Adventurer's Guild for showing us.

That was probably just a ploy to get
you to spread the word about his place.
I want to hear it again.

We can do that as much as we want
later. We've got urgent work to do.
